payload.title: In-memory embedding retriever with cached vectors
payload.description:
## Purpose

Provide the simplest semantic retriever: an in-memory index of normalized embedding vectors with exact cosine search.

## Scope

- In-memory `VectorStore` (default `store.kind: memory`), exact cosine; numpy only as an optional extra.
- Embedding providers as optional extras: `openai` (`text-embedding-3-small`, 512 dims, for the experiment), `local-onnx`, and a `fake` hashing embedder for specs.
- Vector cache keyed by (provider, model, dimensions, normalized-text SHA-256); fingerprint includes model and revision. Embedding only in an explicit opt-in step; never on import or in specs.
- Owner question Q5 (embedding default for customer data: API egress vs local ONNX) stays open; do not pick a customer default here. Phase 3.

## Definition of done

Specs first with the `fake` embedder and no network: exact top-k by cosine, label filter, target exclusion, cache hit on re-run, fingerprint changes with model/dims. `make test` green. Cost: $0 in core.

## Acceptance scenario

```gherkin
Feature: In-memory embedding retriever with cached vectors
  Scenario: Exact nearest neighbours per label without the target
    Given a labeled pool embedded with the fake embedder
    When the target asks for the top 4 items of each label
    Then the results are the exact cosine neighbours, exclude the target, and break ties by ID
  Scenario: Cached vectors are reused
    Given a vector cache written by an earlier run
    When the same pool is indexed again
    Then no embedding call is made
```
